name: Well with its sweep (our own design)
about: Made by tools/battle-models (scenery). Metres; x forward, y right, z up. A battle model: `part` says which part each point belongs to; `parts` are the parts (parent, pivot, axis of turning, way of sliding); `sockets` are named places for flash, smoke, fire and wake; `clips` move the parts. Turns: +t degrees about an axis carries p to p cos t + (axis x p) sin t + axis (axis . p)(1 - cos t), about the part's pivot. Paints: 0 log, 1 log_end, 2 plank, 3 board, 4 thatch, 5 thatch_dark, 6 whitewash, 7 plinth, 8 frame, 9 shutter, 10 glass, 11 door, 12 brick, 13 plaster, 14 soot, 15 char, 16 ash, 17 birch_bark, 18 birch_mark, 19 birch_leaf, 20 twig, 21 spruce, 22 spruce_dark, 23 bark, 24 snow, 25 hay, 26 hay_old, 27 wood, 28 withy, 29 pole, 30 insulator
